primary_metric: D30 retention (>=1 successful transaction in days 0-29)
secondary_metrics: post-window successful transactions per assigned customer
denominator: all assigned customers in the arm, whether or not they redeemed (intent to treat)
outcome_filter: successful transactions only; Failed and Reversed rows are excluded
multiple_comparisons: Segment confidence intervals are exploratory and unadjusted.
causal_scope: Valid for randomized eligible populations in this synthetic simulation only.

estimated: Offer Simulator sheet in the Excel workbook

assumptions.contribution_margin_source: stated planning assumption, not a measured figure
assumptions.txns_per_incremental_retained_source: derived = sum(incremental_transactions) / sum(incremental_retained_customers) across all randomized segments
